theses.name: Alphabet Inc. (Class C)
theses.thesis: Same underlying business as GOOGL (Class A, thesis #11) - Alphabet's Class C shares carry no voting rights and trade within a few dollars of Class A. See GOOGL's thesis for the full cloud-growth/antitrust signal set; logged here only to capture the share-class-specific facts.

signals.name: no_voting_rights
signals.rationale: Class C shares carry no voting rights (vs. Class A's one vote/share and Class B's 10 votes/share, held by founders/insiders) - a structural governance discount that has historically kept GOOG trading close to but not above GOOGL, despite identical economic claims on the business

signals.name: near_parity_with_googl
signals.rationale: GOOG trading at $345.88 vs. GOOGL at $349.54 (thesis #11, same day) - essentially at parity, meaning GOOG buyers get the identical economic exposure to the cloud-growth/antitrust thesis at a slight discount for foregoing voting rights

theses.name: Bunge Global SA
theses.thesis: Global agribusiness posting an 88% revenue surge and near-doubled EBIT as the Viterra merger integrates ahead of schedule, with FY guidance raised twice this year - a scale-driven re-rating story, though still down sharply from its 52-week high

signals.name: viterra_integration
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: net income attributable to shareholders +92% YoY to $678M; net sales +88% YoY to $24.0B; gross profit more than doubled to $1.68B; adjusted segment EBIT more than doubled to $796M - Viterra deal (closed July 2025, ~65.6M shares + ~$1.9B cash) expanded origination/processing footprint especially in Argentina

signals.name: guidance_raised
signals.rationale: Raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $9.25-$9.75; achieved Viterra cost synergies ahead of plan, with management leaning on buybacks alongside the integration as its capital strategy

signals.name: valuation_off_highs
signals.rationale: Trading at $115.58 vs. a 52-week high of $134.87 (low $76.01), P/E ~23x - a merger-integration story still working through a large combined balance sheet and integration execution risk, not yet fully re-rated back toward its highs

theses.name: AutoZone, Inc.
theses.thesis: Auto-parts retailer with consistent mid-single-digit same-store sales growth, but running with $12.4B in net debt and negative book equity from two decades of aggressive buybacks, and now absorbing real tariff cost pressure on imported parts

signals.name: consistent_comp_growth
signals.rationale: Q3 FY2026: total sales $4.84B (+8.4% YoY), total company same-store sales +3.9% (domestic +4.1%); Q4 FY2026 consensus calls for $54.22 EPS on $6.71B revenue with 3.6% same-store sales growth (reports Sept 22 2026) - a consistently growing, resilient business

signals.name: tariff_cost_pressure
signals.rationale: Effective import taxes on auto parts (many sourced from China, Germany, Japan) have risen to 17.4%, the highest since 1935; Q3 included a non-cash $20M LIFO charge tied to tariff-driven cost increases, though underlying gross margin (ex-LIFO) was actually up 20bps

signals.name: negative_equity_leverage
signals.rationale: Carries $12.4B in net debt and negative book equity, both consequences of an aggressive buyback program that has retired over 100% of shares outstanding since 1998; completed an $849M senior notes offering (4.95%, due 2031) in July 2026, adding to long-term debt of $9.0B (+1.85% YoY)

theses.name: AT&T Inc.
theses.thesis: Telecom turnaround delivering record fiber/fixed-wireless net adds and its strongest wireless growth in years, funding a ~4.4% dividend and a $45B+ shareholder-return commitment through 2028, at a cheap ~8x earnings multiple

signals.name: record_subscriber_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: adjusted EPS $0.65 beat $0.59 consensus; revenue $31.6B (+2.3% YoY); postpaid phone net adds 432K (vs. ~338.5K expected), strongest consumer postpaid wireless growth in 3+ years; internet net adds 646K (367K fiber + 279K fixed wireless, a record combined figure); now reaches 38.6M+ fiber locations, on track for 40M by year-end

signals.name: capital_return_commitment
signals.rationale: Raised 2026 buyback authorization to $10B; reaffirmed commitment to $45B+ in shareholder returns (dividends + buybacks) through 2028; stock trades at ~8x earnings with a ~4.4% dividend yield and an investment-grade credit rating - cheap for the growth rate now showing up in subscriber numbers

signals.name: legacy_business_drag
signals.rationale: Guidance held flat rather than raised (adjusted EPS $2.25-$2.35, FCF >=$18B) despite the subscriber beat - legacy wireline and enterprise wireline declines, plus ongoing fiber capex intensity, keep the overall growth algorithm modest even as the consumer-facing metrics improve

theses.name: Alliant Energy Corporation
theses.thesis: Midwest regulated utility raising 2026 sales-growth guidance on faster-than-expected Iowa data center demand (Google, Meta, QTS all under construction), targeting 60% demand growth by 2031 - but the stock has fallen ~9% in the past month against that bullish story

signals.name: data_center_demand_raise
signals.rationale: Temperature-normalized electric sales +3% YoY on Wisconsin C&I demand plus initial Iowa data-center load ramp; raised 2026 sales-growth guidance to 2-3% from 1%, explicitly citing faster-than-expected data center demand; targeting 60% demand growth by 2031 and 7%+ EPS CAGR through 2029

signals.name: named_hyperscaler_projects
signals.rationale: Three large loads under active construction: Google transmission service in Cedar Rapids, QTS's 7-building Cedar Rapids campus (300MW initial energization expected later in 2026), and Meta in vertical construction in Beaver Dam; signed an additional 370MW agreement and plans to file a 900MW ICR for a second Iowa project; pipeline represents 2-4GW of potential future load

signals.name: stock_selloff_despite_good_news
signals.rationale: Shares down 3.88% over the past week and 9.45% over the past month despite the guidance raise - trading at $67.65 against a 52-week high of $78.81, suggesting broader rate-sensitive utility-sector pressure (or execution skepticism on the data-center buildout timeline) is outweighing the fundamental news

theses.name: American Tower Corporation
theses.thesis: Tower/data-center REIT with record CoreSite (data center) leasing for a 5th straight quarter of double-digit growth, raised CoreSite guidance, and a ~4.1% dividend yield - a genuine AI-infrastructure-adjacent beneficiary with REIT-level stability

signals.name: coresite_data_center_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: total revenue +4.7% YoY to $2,749M, property revenue +6.3% to $2,688M; CoreSite data center revenue +12% YoY, 5th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth, record leasing activity; net income +133.2% YoY to $888M (aided by FX gains)

signals.name: coresite_guidance_raised
signals.rationale: CoreSite revenue growth guidance lifted to ~15% for 2026, up from 13%, on strong leasing demand, pricing strength, and faster interconnection activity; global tower organic growth ex-DISH churn reached 4%

signals.name: dish_churn
signals.rationale: Headline property revenue growth is still diluted by ongoing DISH-related tenant churn on the legacy tower business - underlying growth excluding DISH churn (>7% cash FX-neutral) is meaningfully better than the reported headline number

signals.name: dividend_income
signals.rationale: Quarterly dividend $1.79/share, yield ~4.1%; 2026 discretionary capex plan directs ~85% toward developed-market platforms including >$700M for data center capacity - a REIT reinvesting heavily into its highest-growth segment while still paying a real yield

theses.name: Albemarle Corporation
theses.thesis: Lithium producer riding a sharp price recovery to a 155% EBITDA surge, with 13 of 13 covering analysts rating it a buy - a pure, high-torque bet on lithium prices staying elevated for EV/storage demand

signals.name: lithium_price_recovery
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net sales $1.74B (+31.1% YoY), net income $480M (vs. $22.9M a year earlier), adjusted EBITDA +155% to $858.1M, adjusted diluted EPS $3.75 vs. $0.11 - beat consensus EPS of $3.03 and revenue estimates by 9.4%; Energy Storage realized prices +60.5% YoY to $19.53/kg LCE

signals.name: fy_guidance
signals.rationale: Under current ~$20/kg LCE pricing (roughly Q1 2026 averages), FY2026 guidance is $5.7-6.0B net sales and $2.4-2.6B adjusted EBITDA - guidance explicitly tied to the current price scenario, meaning results move directly with lithium prices from here

signals.name: commodity_price_dependence
signals.rationale: The entire earnings recovery story is a lithium-price story (Chinese lithium carbonate ~CNY 182,500/ton in May 2026) - a pure-commodity cyclical whose prior EBITDA collapse (to near-zero EPS a year ago) shows how fast the reverse can happen if prices roll over again

signals.name: valuation_after_rally
signals.rationale: Stock at $115.05 against a 52-week range of $79.30-$221.00 and an average analyst target of $172.56 - already well off its lows but still far below its highs, reflecting how violently this name re-rates in both directions with lithium prices

theses.name: Adobe Inc.
theses.thesis: Record revenue and 1B+ monthly active users with AI-first ARR up 150%, but the stock is down 28% over the past year on persistent worry that generative AI tools will disrupt Adobe's creative-software moat faster than Firefly can monetize it

signals.name: record_revenue_and_users
signals.rationale: Q3 FY2026: record revenue $6.76B (+13% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $6.13 (+15% YoY); monthly active users surpassed 1B for the first time (+20%+ YoY), creative freemium MAU crossed 100M (+70%); raised FY guidance to $26.576-26.626B revenue

signals.name: ai_first_arr_growth
signals.rationale: AI-first ending ARR exceeded $650M, +150% YoY; Firefly ending ARR grew 40% sequentially - real, accelerating monetization of the AI product line, not just usage metrics

signals.name: ai_disruption_fear
signals.rationale: Shares fell 4.45% on the earnings beat itself, and stock is down 28% over the past year - 'analyst downgrades and rising AI competition concerns' cited as weighing on sentiment despite the actual results; market questioning whether Firefly can outrun generative-AI creative tools eroding Adobe's core moat

signals.name: leadership_transition
signals.rationale: CEO Shantanu Narayen (29-year tenure) transitioning to Executive Chair, with Anil Chakravarthy becoming President and CEO December 1 2026 - a leadership change during a critical AI-strategy inflection point adds execution-risk uncertainty

theses.name: A. O. Smith Corporation
theses.thesis: Water heater/boiler maker beating estimates on North American boiler strength and pricing, but China sales collapsing (-28% local currency) forced a guidance narrowing and a strategic review of the China business

signals.name: na_boiler_strength
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS $1.03 beat Zacks consensus by 7.3%; North America sales +5% on 21% boiler sales growth, carryover pricing, and the Leonard Valve acquisition; lifted share buyback authorization to $300M

signals.name: china_slump
signals.rationale: Rest-of-World segment sales fell 19% to $195M; China sales down 28% in local currency on weak consumer demand; company narrowed FY2026 sales guidance to 2-3% (from 2-4%) specifically citing softer residential water heater demand, and its strategic review of the China business is nearing completion

signals.name: input_cost_pressure
signals.rationale: Adjusted segment margin fell 100bps YoY to 24.4%; steel costs rose ~20% YoY, and combined with tariffs and other inflation, largely offset pricing benefits; EPS guidance trimmed to $3.70-$3.85 from $3.70-$4.00

theses.name: AbbVie Inc.
theses.thesis: Post-Humira immunology franchise (Skyrizi + Rinvoq) now generating ~$8B/quarter and more than offsetting continued sharp Humira biosimilar erosion, with guidance raised again - the succession story is working as planned

signals.name: skyrizi_rinvoq_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: Skyrizi sales $5.5B (+24% operational), market-leading in 30+ countries; Rinvoq sales >$2.5B (+23.7% operational), on pace for 30% global growth this year; combined Skyrizi+Rinvoq ~$8.03B, more than offsetting Humira's decline

signals.name: guidance_raised
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net revenue $16.99B (+10.2% YoY), adjusted diluted EPS +22.9% to $3.65; raised full-year revenue guidance by $300M to $67.6B, adjusted EPS guidance $13.87-$14.07

signals.name: humira_erosion
signals.rationale: Humira global sales fell 36.1% operationally to $756M on continued biosimilar competition - a well-flagged, expected decline, but still a real headwind the immunology franchise must keep outrunning

signals.name: valuation
signals.rationale: Trading around $264, P/E ~74x - a high multiple even after adjusting for one-time items, pricing in continued flawless execution on the Skyrizi/Rinvoq/oncology pipeline transition

theses.name: American Express Company
theses.thesis: Premium card network posting the strongest card-member spending growth in three years with improving credit quality, raising full-year revenue guidance, though the stock trades well off its 52-week high on broader spending-cycle concerns

signals.name: record_spending_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: revenue +10% YoY (4th straight quarter of double-digit growth), EPS $4.53 (+11% YoY); billed business +9% FX-adjusted to $455.8B, the highest spend growth rate in three years; guidance raised to 10% full-year revenue growth

signals.name: improving_credit_quality
signals.rationale: Provision for credit losses fell to $1.1B from $1.4B YoY on a reserve release vs. a prior-year reserve build; 30+ days past due improved to 1.2% of balances (from 1.3%); net write-off rate held steady at 2.0% - credit book getting healthier, not riskier, even as spend accelerates

signals.name: valuation_off_highs
signals.rationale: Stock at $311.76 vs. a 52-week high of $387.49 (low $290.97) despite the guidance raise - P/E ~18.9x, suggesting the market isn't fully rewarding the spend/credit trends yet, or is pricing in a broader spending slowdown ahead

theses.name: Chevron Corporation
theses.thesis: Major integrated oil producer with record US output post-Hess acquisition, capturing synergies well ahead of schedule and cutting capex per barrel, with Guyana offering a long growth runway into the 2030s

signals.name: record_production_and_earnings
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 earnings $12.1B ($6.11/share), operating cash flow $19.7B; net oil-equivalent production 4.07M boe/d, +20% YoY on the Hess acquisition plus Permian/Gulf of America growth; US production hit a record 2.077M boe/d

signals.name: hess_synergies_ahead_of_schedule
signals.rationale: Hess acquisition's one-year anniversary: Chevron captured 50% more synergies than initially targeted, with $1.5B realized six months ahead of schedule; Guyana called a world-class asset expected to extend high-margin oil growth into the 2030s

signals.name: capex_discipline
signals.rationale: Expects to spend 25% less capex per barrel of oil equivalent in 2026 vs. last year; achieved $3B in annual structural cost reductions six months ahead of target, >70% from efficiency gains rather than cuts to activity

signals.name: oil_price_dependence
signals.rationale: As an integrated major, earnings still ultimately track the price of oil - the production growth and synergy story is real, but a sustained oil-price downturn would compress earnings across the whole portfolio regardless of operational execution

theses.name: Brown-Forman Corporation
theses.thesis: Spirits maker guiding to flat organic sales and a 3-5% organic operating income decline for the year - Jack Daniel's core brand is essentially flat while innovation (Tennessee Blackberry) offsets weakness in tequila and used barrels

signals.name: flat_jack_daniels
signals.rationale: Q1 FY2027 (ended July 31 2026): net sales -1% to $911M, operating income -3% reported (+4% organic); Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey organic sales essentially flat, with weakness in used barrels, tequila, and developed international markets

signals.name: innovation_offset
signals.rationale: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Blackberry innovation drove growth this quarter, helping offset core brand softness; diluted EPS +6% to $0.38 despite the sales decline

signals.name: fy_guidance_decline
signals.rationale: Reaffirmed FY2027 outlook of roughly flat organic net sales and a 3-5% DECLINE in organic operating income - a company guiding to shrinking profitability for the year, not just a soft quarter

signals.name: tariff_exposure
signals.rationale: Company flags trade-policy/tariff risk on both US and foreign sides as a factor that could pressure margins, sales, and distributor economics - a real, disclosed risk factor for a globally-distributed spirits brand, even without a specific dollar impact quantified yet

theses.name: Aptiv PLC
theses.thesis: Auto supplier diversifying into robotics/data centers/energy storage with a healthy $20B bookings pace, but core automotive revenue is declining (Europe -8%) and the company just cut its 2026 revenue forecast by $300M

signals.name: bookings_and_diversification
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: $5B in new business awards, $10B YTD bookings, on track for a $20B full-year target; non-auto revenue growth +12%, with expansion into robotics, drones, energy storage, and data centers reducing pure-auto dependence

signals.name: guidance_cut
signals.rationale: Cut 2026 revenue forecast by $300M; automotive revenue declined 1% in Q2 with Europe down 8% on volume pressure from select luxury OEMs; second-half vehicle production outlook flipped from a tailwind to a headwind

signals.name: stock_off_highs
signals.rationale: Stock down 50.8% from its 52-week high; analysts remain bullish on the longer-term ADAS/electrification/software thesis but have lowered price targets (Evercore ISI to $70 from $80, Barclays to $65 from $73), implying meaningful upside is still seen from here despite the cut

theses.name: AppLovin Corporation
theses.thesis: Ad-tech platform posting explosive revenue/EBITDA growth as its AXON 2 AI engine opens to all advertisers, but analyst price targets have been slashed repeatedly on execution questions even as fundamentals stay strong

signals.name: revenue_and_margin_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue $1.92B (+53% YoY), adjusted EBITDA $1.61B (+58% YoY) at 84% margin; net income from continuing operations $1.27B (+64% YoY); net revenue per install +58% despite a 2% decline in install volume

signals.name: axon2_platform_opening
signals.rationale: AXON 2 AI engine opened to all advertisers in June 2026, expected to broaden reach across app categories and improve operating leverage/return on ad spend - a real platform expansion, not just guidance

signals.name: execution_questions_and_downgrades
signals.rationale: Results fell slightly short of guidance on timing of model improvements; price targets cut repeatedly in Aug-Sept 2026 - Morgan Stanley to $450 from $650, Benchmark to $440 from $500, BTIG to $408 from $574 - a steep repricing of growth expectations even without a single specific negative catalyst cited

theses.name: AES Corporation
theses.thesis: Power generator with a fast-growing 12.6GW contracted renewables backlog including major data-center PPAs (Meta), but the stock trades right at its agreed $15.00/share buyout price from a GIP/EQT-led consortium - upside is effectively capped pending deal close

signals.name: data_center_ppa_backlog
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: signed 1.6GW in new PPAs entirely with data-center customers (incl. 650MW with Meta), raising contracted renewables backlog to 12GW; total backlog 12.6GW under signed PPAs including 5.6GW under construction; revenue $3.4B, operating profit $630M

signals.name: pending_buyout
signals.rationale: Stockholders approved acquisition by a Global Infrastructure Partners/EQT-led consortium at $15.00/share cash (~$10.7B equity value, ~$33.4B enterprise value incl. debt), expected to close late 2026/early 2027; stock trading at $14.78, essentially at the deal price - little room left for upside unless the deal breaks

signals.name: leverage
signals.rationale: Total debt $32.12B as of Q2 2026 ($6.1B recourse, $25.2B non-recourse) - a heavily leveraged balance sheet, part of the rationale for going private rather than continuing to fund renewable buildout as a public company

theses.name: Alexandria Real Estate Equities
theses.thesis: Life-science-focused office REIT reaffirming FY guidance and improving leasing, but FFO down 26% YoY on occupancy pressure, big impairments, and a 45% dividend cut - value trap or bottoming, not resolved yet

signals.name: leasing_improvement
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: 1.039M sq ft signed (75% from existing tenants), ~950K sq ft expected Q3 leasing plus 1.4M sq ft already leased scheduled to commence; adjusted FFO $1.73/share, FY26 guidance reaffirmed at $6.40 midpoint with a tightened range

signals.name: occupancy_and_ffo_decline
signals.rationale: FFO down 26% YoY; occupancy fell 80bps sequentially to 86.9% (expected to end 2026 around 87%); $222M in real estate impairments this quarter alone, driven by aggressive asset sales and a weak public-biotech tenant sector

signals.name: dividend_cut
signals.rationale: Cut quarterly dividend to $0.72/share, a 45% reduction from $1.32 the prior quarter - a REIT dividend cut of this size signals management doesn't expect cash flow to recover quickly

signals.name: diversifying_tenant_mix
signals.rationale: Advanced-technology and tools/services tenants are making up a growing share of new leasing activity, partially offsetting continued weakness from public biotech tenants - a genuine mix shift, not just guidance rhetoric

theses.name: Air Products and Chemicals
theses.thesis: Industrial gas producer beating EPS guidance on volume/price strength and building out a large green-hydrogen project pipeline (NEOM, TotalEnergies), but just took a massive $2.9B pre-tax charge exiting several projects

signals.name: eps_beat_and_margin
signals.rationale: Q3 FY2026 EPS $3.47, +12% YoY, above guidance on improved volume and higher equity-affiliate contributions; operating margin 25.6%, up YoY on volume/price improvement

signals.name: hydrogen_pipeline
signals.rationale: NEOM Green Hydrogen project (257 wind turbines for 1.6GW wind + a Manhattan-sized 2.2GW solar farm) now has a marketing/distribution deal with Yara for renewable ammonia, eliminating volume risk; separate 15-year TotalEnergies agreement to supply 70,000 tons/year of green hydrogen from 2030

signals.name: project_exit_charges
signals.rationale: FY2026 results include ~$2.9B pre-tax ($2.2B after-tax, $9.92/share) in charges tied to project exit decisions announced June 30 2026 - a large writedown signaling some of the ambitious clean-energy project pipeline isn't panning out as planned

signals.name: stock_off_highs
signals.rationale: Trading at $301.27, down from a 52-week high of $314.87 (low $229.11) - market still digesting the size of the project-exit charge against otherwise solid core operating results

theses.name: Accenture plc
theses.thesis: Global IT/consulting leader landing record large-deal AI bookings and a new $1B AI-evaluation partnership with Anthropic, but Q3 new bookings actually declined YoY and Q4 guidance was widened on Middle East disruption and delayed managed-services awards

signals.name: record_ai_bookings
signals.rationale: Record 129 quarterly client bookings >$100M and $5.9B in generative AI new bookings for FY2025; 104 quarterly $100M+ bookings year-to-date in FY2026, up 13% - AI remains a genuine tailwind even as headline bookings softened

signals.name: anthropic_partnership
signals.rationale: New partnership with Anthropic: $1B investment each in AI evaluation, sent shares up 8% after hours on the announcement

signals.name: bookings_decline
signals.rationale: Q3 FY2026 new bookings $19.32B, down 2% in USD (3% in local currency) YoY; late-quarter Middle East disruption and delayed managed-services awards widened the range of possible Q4 outcomes, with revenue guided to only 1-5% local-currency growth

signals.name: analyst_downgrade
signals.rationale: Downgraded to Neutral at Guggenheim after a 52% rebound in the stock - valuation seen as having caught up to the recovery story ahead of Q4 earnings due Oct 1 2026

theses.name: 3M Company
theses.thesis: Industrial conglomerate posting steady organic growth and raised guidance under new leadership, still paying down a massive multi-decade PFAS liability with a $10.3B water-suppliers settlement and ongoing state-level deals

signals.name: organic_growth_and_margin
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: GAAP sales $6.5B (+2.4% YoY), adjusted organic growth +5.4%, operating margin 24.9% (+40bps), adjusted EPS +11% to $2.40, free cash flow $1.3B at 107% conversion; guidance raised on strong first-half performance

signals.name: pfas_water_settlement
signals.rationale: Public Water Suppliers PFAS settlement carries a pre-tax present-value commitment of up to $10.3B payable over 13 years for remediation - the largest single piece of 3M's PFAS liability overhang

signals.name: state_pfas_settlements
signals.rationale: Separately resolved PFAS claims with New Jersey: ~$210M for legacy Chambers Works litigation plus ~$75M for statewide claims running 2030-2050 - state-by-state settlements continue to accumulate on top of the federal water-suppliers deal

signals.name: dividend_and_valuation
signals.rationale: Trading at $168.56 within a $139-185 52-week range, dividend yield ~1.9%, market cap ~$83B - priced for steady industrial execution with the PFAS liability now substantially quantified rather than open-ended

theses.name: Abbott Laboratories
theses.thesis: Diversified healthcare (devices/diagnostics/nutrition) growing steadily and raising guidance, but still absorbing over $1B in infant-formula/NEC litigation settlements with ~1,700 lawsuits still pending

signals.name: devices_diagnostics_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 reported sales +13.0% to $12.6B, comparable sales +4.8%, adjusted EPS $1.312 beat guidance; Medical Devices comparable sales +8.4% (Electrophysiology low-teens, Rhythm Management +9.5%); CGM sales exceeded $2B, +9.5%; FY26 EPS guidance raised to $5.45-$5.60

signals.name: exact_sciences_acquisition
signals.rationale: Exact Sciences acquisition completed March 2026 contributed $1.0B in sales and established a cancer-diagnostics presence

signals.name: nec_formula_litigation
signals.rationale: Two formula-related settlements since August 2026 total ~$1.055B (a ~$385M powdered-formula settlement plus a $670M NEC/Gill settlement); ~1,700 lawsuits covering ~12,700 infants still pending in federal/state courts as of August 2026

signals.name: diagnostics_softness
signals.rationale: Rapid and Molecular Diagnostics sales declined 8% on a weaker-than-normal respiratory virus season; Core Laboratory China sales pressured by challenging local market conditions

theses.name: Allstate Corporation
theses.thesis: Auto/home insurer riding a quiet catastrophe year and disciplined underwriting to sharply improved margins, though homeowners premium increases raise affordability questions that could eventually draw regulatory pushback

signals.name: combined_ratio_improvement
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 Property-Liability combined ratio 86.6%, a 4.5pt improvement YoY (from 91.1%); catastrophe losses down 13.5% YoY to $1.7B; net income jumped 56% on underwriting strength

signals.name: segment_underwriting_gains
signals.rationale: Auto combined ratio improved 2.7pts to 83.3%; Homeowners combined ratio improved 7.4pts to 94.6% on higher earned premiums and lower catastrophe losses

signals.name: homeowners_affordability
signals.rationale: Margin improvement is partly built on higher homeowners premiums; reporting frames this as an 'uncomfortable reality for homeowners' - a trend that risks state-level rate pushback or policy non-renewal backlash if it continues

signals.name: quiet_cat_year
signals.rationale: Current margins are flattered by a below-average catastrophe year - underlying combined ratio (ex-catastrophe effects) was roughly flat YoY at 79.4% vs 79.5%, so the reported improvement leans more on favorable weather/reserve releases than a structural underwriting gain

theses.name: Baker Hughes Company
theses.thesis: Oilfield services/energy equipment supplier riding record data-center power and LNG equipment orders after closing the Chart Industries acquisition, beating estimates for a 10th straight quarter

signals.name: record_iet_orders
signals.rationale: Q2 2026: IET segment booked record $7.1B in orders, doubling YoY, backlog up 19% to an all-time high - driven by $2.6B in power systems (incl. 2.7GW of gas turbines for data centers/mobile power) and $1.8B in LNG equipment across 3 major projects

signals.name: chart_acquisition
signals.rationale: Closed the Chart Industries acquisition in early July 2026, expected to deliver $325M in annualized cost synergies by year three; also sold Waygate for ~$1.45B, actively reshaping the portfolio

signals.name: q2_beat
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue $6.7B, net income $681M, adjusted EPS $0.64, adjusted EBITDA $1.23B (exceeded guidance range) - 10th consecutive quarter beating estimates

signals.name: oilfield_services_cyclicality
signals.rationale: Legacy OFSE (Oilfield Services & Equipment) segment remains exposed to oil/gas capex cyclicality even as the newer power/LNG equipment business diversifies the story - a commodity-price downturn would still pressure the larger, older half of the business

theses.name: Archer Daniels Midland
theses.thesis: Crush and ethanol margins driving a sharp earnings recovery and repeated guidance raises, but the name is still working through the fallout of a 2026 SEC accounting-fraud settlement over its Nutrition segment

signals.name: crush_margin_strength
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS $1.84 (+98% YoY), revenue +7.1% to $22.68B beating consensus; Ag Services & Oilseeds segment operating profit +129% YoY to $867M on strong North American soybean crushing

signals.name: guidance_raised
